name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: Turns your AI coding assistant into a security auditor that maps your app, hunts for real vulnerabilities, double-checks each one, and writes a professional report.
buyer: A boutique security consultancy or freelance pentester who wants to cover more client codebases per week without hiring more auditors.
business_use_cases: A one-person security consultancy runs it against client codebases as a first-pass audit before spending billable hours on manual review.
A software agency runs it on every client project before handoff and attaches the generated report as a deliverable, justifying a security line-item on the invoice.
A bug-bounty hunter uses the coverage-ledger approach to systematically work through a large target instead of poking around randomly.

money_ideas.idea: Offer 'AI-assisted security audit' as a fixed-price add-on service, using this to do the first 80% of the work.
Run it on a schedule against subscribing clients' repos and sell it as continuous security monitoring.

steal_this: Offer a $500 flat-rate 'AI security audit' for indie SaaS founders this weekend, running this skill and hand-editing the report before delivery.
